# Hospitality Loyalty Optimization — Personalized offers with measurable incrementality

Generated July 26, 2026 — Sales Brief

Leading hotel brand — A Blend360 Case Study

## Executive Summary

Blend360 developed an automated promotion optimization platform that predicts the incremental effect of individual offers, assigns promotions within budget and eligibility constraints, embeds treatment and control design, and retrains from observed results. Optimized offers produced statistically significant incremental travel, while random offers generated negligible incremental revenue at substantial cost. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])

## The Challenge

The hotel brand needed to influence new travel without spending rewards on stays that would have happened anyway. Assignment also had to respect overall budget, minimum ROI, regional rules, loyalty-tier limits, and offer-level constraints. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])

## Our Solution

The workflow qualifies guests, forecasts future nights and offer uplift, optimizes assignment, creates treatment and control groups, produces target lists, measures incremental nights and revenue, and retrains the uplift model from actual outcomes. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])

## Key Features

- **Individual uplift prediction** — Estimates how a specific offer changes nights or revenue for a specific guest. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])
- **Constrained optimization** — Maximizes revenue while enforcing budget, ROI, geography, tier, and offer rules. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])
- **Experiment design** — Builds untreated and random-offer holdouts into campaign execution. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])
- **Closed-loop learning** — Tracks incremental performance and retrains with current results. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])
- **Modular platform** — Reuses common infrastructure for additional journey and planning objectives. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])

## Quantified Outcomes

- **$24M annualized** — Projected incremental revenue from the initial personalized-promotion round. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])
- **$1.2M annualized** — Projected promotion cost savings versus unoptimized deployment. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])
- **+85% promotion ROI** — Projected from greater guest revenue when personalized offers were added. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])
- **.95 significance** — Optimized offers increased new travel versus untreated holdout. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])

## Business Value

The solution connects personalization decisions directly to incrementality, cost, and experimental evidence rather than redemption alone. **Inference:** It provides a reusable pattern for loyalty programs that must allocate scarce incentives across many customers and policy constraints. ([Blend Hospitality Case Study - Loyalty Optimization.pptx])

## Known Gaps / Caveats

- **Projected versus realized** — The annualized revenue, savings, and ROI values are projections based on one mature quarter, not full-year realized totals.
- **Client confidentiality** — The hotel brand is not named in the source.
